# Go To Market And Content

Use this instruction when shaping external messaging and acquisition.

## Core Focus

- Define a clear position for a specific coach segment and concrete problem.
- Create a landing page that explains the product, shows examples, and drives action.
- Produce 2-3 short demo videos.
- Create a quick-start guide for building a coaching AI tool in 15 minutes.
- Plan outreach through email, direct messages, coach groups, and communities.
- Set up a newsletter with a basic onboarding sequence.

## Checklist

- [ ] Define product positioning for a concrete coach persona.
- [ ] Create the landing page.
- [ ] Create short demo videos.
- [ ] Create the quick-start guide.
- [ ] Plan and execute outreach to coaches.
- [ ] Set up the newsletter and onboarding sequence.

## Output Expectations

- Keep messaging concrete and example-driven.
- Show outcomes for coaches, not just platform capabilities.
- Align GTM language with the same non-technical tone used in the product.
